name: Translator (Girug'kagh)
description: Girug'kagh translators serve as emissaries and diplomatic intermediaries for K'kree overlords. They work for life as part of a K'kree entourage, with no conventional rank structure or mustering-out benefits. They receive Steward 1 and Diplomat 1 automatically at the start of their career.

translator.name: Translator
translator.description: You serve as a linguistic and diplomatic emissary for K'kree patrons, navigating alien cultures on their behalf.

mishaps.1: You offend your K'kree patron through a cultural misunderstanding. Lose this job but gain a Contact in the alien culture you were navigating.
mishaps.2: A diplomatic incident forces your recall. Gain an Enemy among the foreign delegation.
mishaps.3: You are caught in crossfire during a hostile negotiation. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.4: Your patron K'kree dies. You must find a new patron or leave service. Gain a Contact from the old patron's household.
mishaps.5: You accidentally reveal confidential K'kree information. Gain an Enemy from your patron's rivals.
mishaps.6: You suffer a crisis of loyalty. You may leave service freely — but gain a K'kree Enemy who considers you a traitor.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from the career.
events.3: A tricky negotiation tests every skill you have. Roll Diplomat 8+. Success: gain DM+2 on your next advancement roll. Failure: gain a Rival.
events.4: You accompany your patron on a deep-space voyage. Gain Vacc Suit 1 or Pilot (spacecraft) 1.
events.5: Extended posting on an alien world. Gain Language 1 or Survival 1.
events.6: Your patron requires you to manage a complex household dispute. Gain Steward 1 or Admin 1.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: You attend a major K'kree ceremony. Gain a Contact among K'kree dignitaries and SOC +1.
events.9: A foreign dignitary takes a liking to you. Gain an Ally.
events.10: Your skill in a critical situation impresses your patron. Gain DM+2 on your next advancement roll.
events.11: Your patron elevates you to a position of particular trust. Gain SOC +1 and Diplomat 1.
events.12: You broker a historic agreement between the K'kree and another species. Gain one rank and SOC +1.

notes: Girug'kagh only. Translators receive Steward 1 and Diplomat 1 automatically at career start. No cash mustering-out benefits — service is considered lifelong.
